note: labels by Claude (a different model from the readers under test), from the image only
labeler: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), looking at each photo (zoomed crops where needed). No OCR, no reader output and no Commons description text or file name was used for the values. The readers under test are PP-OCRv4 and Qwen3.5 (OpenVINO).
source: Wikimedia Commons photos; per-image author and license in data/real_tw2/ATTRIBUTION.md
selection: Second blind set, same method as real_tw plus an uploader cap. Commons search, file namespace ("uniform invoice", "e-invoice", 電子發票, 統一發票, intitle:receipt Taiwan; JPEG/PNG; CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA or public domain) gave 778 candidate files after dropping titles about invoice boxes, notices, prize lists, specimens, bank or card slips, tickets and medical or school fees. The 72 files drawn for real_tw (41 kept, 31 excluded) and exact re-uploads of them (same SHA-1) were removed, leaving 708 files from 32 uploaders. Uploader cap, fixed before any photo was looked at: at most 5 files per uploader (uploader = user of the file's first revision). Draw: Python random.Random(20261107).sample(sorted(pool), len(pool)), walked in that order, skipping a file whose uploader already had 5 draws, stopping at 72 draws or the end of the pool; the pool ran out after 51 draws from 32 uploaders. 34 of the 51 were dropped after looking at them (reason per file in excluded_from_sample): not a sales voucher, several documents in one photo, or personal data such as a person's name (including the owner's name printed in a seller stamp), a phone number, a card or member number, or a vehicle plate. The other 17 are this set (11 uploaders; uploader per photo in docs[].uploader). Correction made during the build: the first run of the draw counted the user of each file's latest revision, so bot re-uploads (Rotatebot, SteinsplitterBot) hid the original uploader and one uploader got more than 5 draws. The draw was rerun with the same pool, seed and walk, counting the first-revision uploader; draws_removed_by_uploader_fix lists the 13 files the faulty run had drawn that the corrected run does not. Their photos had been looked at; none of them is in this set.

value_rules.date: transaction date as YYYY-MM-DD (ROC years converted)
value_rules.seller_ubn: 8 digits; null when the voucher prints no seller UBN
value_rules.total: integer NT$ the buyer paid for this voucher
value_rules.net, tax: integers only when the voucher prints a separate untaxed amount and a tax line; null otherwise (a consumer e-invoice usually prints neither)
value_rules.unreadable: the field is printed but cannot be read with confidence from the photo; it is not scored
